subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars` and `agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars` be writable through the agent-facing Gateway `config.apply`/`config.patch` tool, or should this issue wait for live proof of a restart deletion path before changing that boundary?
rationale: The fields are valid documented config, but the remaining source-proven gap is the model-to-operator Gateway config mutation allowlist; relaxing that allowlist is a maintainer security/product boundary choice, not a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter proves the current-main restart/config-write deletion path and then fixes the implicated path without broadening the Gateway tool boundary prematurely.

options.title: Allow defaults only
options.body: Approve a narrow change that adds only the two `agents.defaults.*` bootstrap limit paths to the Gateway tool allowlist, with focused guard tests and live config.patch or restart proof.

options.title: Allow defaults and per-agent overrides
options.body: Approve the broader default plus `agents.list[]` allowlist expansion if maintainers accept agents tuning all bootstrap profile limits through config.apply/config.patch.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter proves the current-main restart/config-write deletion path and then fixes the implicated path without broadening the Gateway tool boundary prematurely.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history owns the current Gateway config mutation guard lineage, which is the boundary that would need explicit acceptance.
